opening.argument: The video opens as an Office 365 walkthrough for new users and proceeds through ordinary Admin Center tasks. It explains how to manage users, configure services and add-ins, and use built-in reports. The visible interface supports that instructional purpose: one view shows the Active users page with an Add a user control, and another shows Security & privacy settings, including password policy and sharing settings. The account sign-up reference provides access context, while the request to like the video is ordinary audience engagement. Neither changes the character of the walkthrough or establishes deception or a harmful transaction.

citations.quote: This video is intended for brand new users of Office 365. To familiarize yourself with the Admin Center.
Starting with the users area, you'll find that you can add, delete,. Deactivate users here.
Under the settings section, we have services and add-ins.
